Keep your forms, rule files and callbacks in your package; pass data and reference snapshots explicitly.

## Store the resources

Declare `model.form` and `model.validation` in your package's `Imports`.

```text
inst/forms/
  survey-form.yaml
  survey-validation.yaml
  survey-structure-validation.yaml
  survey-generated-validation.yaml
  survey-business-validation.yaml
R/
  checks.R
```

Use separate directories when shipping multiple model versions.

## Load a plan

Register your callback when loading the process:

```r
directory <- system.file("forms", package = "your.package")
plan <- model.validation::load_validation_plan(
  "survey", directory,
  checks = list(total_count = total_count)
)
```

Here `total_count` is your package's callback, as illustrated in the authoring guide.

Keep the plan and checked form unchanged; reuse them across submissions.

## Supply references and Excel data

```r
references <- model.validation::prepare_validation_references(list(
  observers = list(values = "ALICE"),
  stations = list(values = c("001", "002"))
))
data <- model.validation::read_validation_workbook("submission.xlsx")
result <- model.validation::validate_data(plan, data, references, source = "submission.xlsx")
```

Supply code lists and registries from your application's sources. The validation package does not fetch them.

Prepare code lists once per batch. Use `registry_index()` separately for registry matching.

Excel reading preserves cell positions, individual value types, whitespace and textual leading zeros.

It reads cached formula results without recalculation. Excel errors and formulas without cached values become missing.

## Prepare values when needed

Conversion is explicit and runs only after structural checks pass:

```r
result <- model.validation::validate_data(
  plan, data, references,
  prepare_data = function(data) model.validation::prepare_validation_data(data, plan$model)
)
```

This converts string fields to text and midnight timestamps to dates. Other values remain unchanged.

Custom preparation must preserve sheet names, order and dimensions. Preparation errors block content checks.
